content.title: Chapter 102 - UTILITIES — Sec. 102-62. - Access to meter.

faqs.a:
When water service is provided to any property by the city, as a condition of obtaining
               or continuing such water service, it shall be the responsibility of the owner of any
               property so served to provide the city with access to any water meter or related meter
               pit or meter vault for the purpose of reading utility meters, for the purpose of inspection
               and repair of meters, meter pits, meter vaults or the utility system or any part thereof,
               for the purpose of connecting and disconnecting service, and for the purpose of removing
               or replacing meters, or related pits or vaults. If a meter, meter pit, or meter vault
               serving an owner's property becomes obstructed by bushes, landscaping, fencing, trees
               or by any other fixture, decoration, structure or material, and the owner of the property
               otherwise fails to provide access to the meter, meter pit, or meter vault as required
               herein, or if the property owner fails to remove any obstruction to a meter, meter
               pit, or meter vault as required herein, or if the property owner, any agent of the
               property owner, or any tenant or occupant of the property shall deny the city access
               for the purposes described in this
section 102-62
and
section 102-62.1
, then the owner of the property receiving water service shall be in violation of
               this section and shall thereafter be subject to the fees and actions provided for
               in this article.
(Code 1981, § 33-37; Ord. No. 2574, § 1, 11-21-1988;
Ord. No. 4030, § 1, 10-16-2006
)
